body: One load-bearing-test correction from the live diff: the current outcome/cause re-bracket variants use literal spaces, so old 3c1777e already distinguishes them because ContentAddress.digest joins tokens with NUL. To kill the old renderer, use actual control characters. An equal-before-fix pair for the adjacent outcome/cause fields is A: outcome = "o\u0000cause\u0000c", cause = None; B: outcome = "o", cause = "c\u0000cause\u0000". Both old joined streams include the empty-cause/next-field separator identically; the new length tokens distinguish them. Please assert the two variant fingerprints differ and, ideally, explicitly show the pre-fix collision in a small local helper/mutation.
